EndpointFingerprintScheme.description:
Algorithm used to derive a TRACE32 endpoint fingerprint.

This is independent of the document schema version: it identifies the
cryptographic endpoint-binding algorithm.

oneOf.description: Canonical endpoint identity bound to the observed TRACE32 probe.

FirmwareBinding.description: Firmware identity evidence recorded with a histogram.

elf_sha256.description: Digest of the executable used for address and symbol attribution.

proof.description: Evidence proving how the firmware binding was established.

FirmwareBindingProof.description: Evidence type used to establish a firmware binding.

oneOf.description: A deployment artifact bound the executable digest to the target image.

evidence_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the immutable deployment evidence artifact.

An immutable capture request asserted the deployed executable digest without comparing
the target image.

evidence_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the immutable assertion evidence artifact.

oneOf.description: A target-image comparison established or rejected the binding.

evidence_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the immutable target-comparison evidence artifact.

FirmwareBindingStatus.description: The confidence of the firmware identity bound to a capture.

PcHitBucket.description: One half-open address interval and its PC-hit count.

hits.description: Samples whose PC lies in this interval.

DebuggerSymbolization.description: Optional best-effort symbol labels reported by TRACE32 against its stopped PERF result buffer. These labels do not establish firmware identity.

DebuggerSymbolizedLocation.description: A hottest original bucket narrowed to at most four bytes and optionally labeled by TRACE32.

PcSamplingMethod.description: The TRACE32 sampling method that produced a histogram.

oneOf.description: Runtime PC snooping without stopping the target.
Periodically stopping and restarting the target to read its PC.

configured_retained_runtime_percent.description: Retained runtime percentage configured before sampling started.

observed_retained_runtime_percent.description: Retained runtime percentage observed after sampling stopped.

TargetExecutionState.description: A target execution-state observation taken at a capture boundary.

halted.description: Whether TRACE32 reported that the target was halted.

powered.description: Whether TRACE32 reported target power as available.

running.description: Whether TRACE32 reported that the target was running.

description: A bounded PC-hit histogram obtained from TRACE32 PERF sampling.

address_space.description: Address-space identity used for every bucket.

buckets.description: Sorted, pairwise disjoint half-open address buckets.

cleanup_complete.description: Whether cleanup completed before the successful histogram was emitted.

core_id.description: Core that supplied the sampled program counters.

endpoint_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint for the exclusively leased TRACE32 endpoint.

debugger_symbolization.description: Optional TRACE32-reported labels for refined high-hit locations; firmware remains independently unverified.

firmware.description: Firmware identity evidence for symbol attribution.

in_scope_hits.description: Total hits within the declared address scope.

last_sample_rate_hz.description: Last observed sampling-rate snapshot in hertz; this is not an average.

method.description: Sampling method actually reported by TRACE32.

observed_duration_ns.description: Observed host duration from arming PERF to stopping it.

requested_duration_ns.description: Requested capture duration measured on the host.

snoop_failures.description: TRACE32 PC-snoop failures observed during this capture.

target_state_after.description: Target state immediately after stopping PERF.

target_state_before.description: Target state immediately before configuring PERF.

trace32.description: TRACE32 software/build identity observed during capture.
